Comprehension questions
Answer these questions
a. Why are people drawn to stories?
b. Why is the art of story telling known as 'The long lost art?'
c. Story telling has its root in almost every culture. Can you identify their names in different
cultures?
d. Social media has taken us far from these oral traditions. The world now feels we need to
revive this long lost art. Why do you think this need arose?
e. African storytellers are given high official posts in government and they have a special
place in society. Why in your opinion are they so important? Write in detail.
Connectives
Connectives are words or phrases that link sentences (or clauses) together.
Connectives can be conjunctions, (when, but, because) prepositions or adverbs, and
we can constantly use them in written and spoken English.
Connectives can be more than one-word phrases, like 'as well as', 'such as', 'on the
other hand' are all connectors to join a story.
